items.title: Lee Paige Interview, 1961-01-13
items.q: So he turns around to me and joking and said to me, he said, how would you like to be a strip dancer?

ctx.x: Oh, Lee, didn't you at one time, weren't you the only person that ever performed a male striptease for ladies' club?

Yes. Back in about 49, well, I was in a Grover La Rose theatrical booking agency's office in St. Louis, Missouri. And during the time I was in his office, he had a phone call and it was a ladies' club that called up and they wanted something unusual and different. And they specified they'd like a male strip dancer. They asked the agent if there was such a thing as a strip dancer. So he turns around to me and joking and said to me, he said, how would you like to be a strip dancer? And I said, well, if there's any…
Lee, how did these ladies react? Didn't you come, didn't you wear formal clothes or something? How was their reaction?
